blocking_constraint.no_headless_button_injection: penguinscreen2-mb exposes PCSX2_VR_PADLOOK_SEQ / PCSX2_VR_PADSTICK, but VR/PadLook.cpp shows both drive ONLY the right-stick RX byte (0..255). There is no button (Start/X/Circle) seam. Menus therefore cannot be navigated headlessly, which is what gates four of the six lanes.
blocking_constraint.one_dump_per_boot: VMManager.cpp:2949 latches s_dump_fired, so the seam fires exactly once per boot; 'frames' is the multi-frame count of that single dump. One boot per vsync target.

audio.how_found: All 844 AUDO slots replaced with a 3000 Hz burst -> a single burst heard at t=17.3s. Then a 20-frequency group code (200 Hz apart) -> group 0 (slots 0-42) at 800 Hz. Then a UNIQUE frequency per slot (700..4900 Hz, 100 Hz apart) -> 1600 Hz = index 9 = menu-appear_01.

measurement.method: pw-record of the PipeWire sink monitor over the boot window; 0.10 s Hann windows, 50% overlap, +-40 Hz band

audio.slot: nfl2k5ps2.audio.audo.o0009.c0033 = menu-appear_01 (outer entry 9, chunk 33, mono, 16000 Hz)

colors.what_it_would_take: A real game screen: kickoff/gameplay reached from a cold boot, which needs Start + menu navigation. No headless button seam exists (see blocking_constraint).
colors.what_was_built: All 634 Unif packages (317 HOME + 317 AWAY), facemask AND turtleneck -> #FF00FF magenta
colors.why_not: The only input-free screen that draws a helmet is the in-engine intro montage at v4800. Booting the combined patched image there produced a GS dump byte-identical to the stock boot (md5 91f363c7160cf73cc45e25f0185999f6 both) and a PIXEL-IDENTICAL frame (full-frame ImageChops diff bbox = None, 0 magenta pixels in 640x480). The intro cinematic evidently draws its own baked model/material set, not the gameplay Unif colour packages.

playbook.what_it_would_take: Button injection: cold boot, Start, navigate to a game, open the play-call menu.
playbook.why: As the brief predicted. The play-call menu IS on screen in states 04/05/06 ('CHOOSE PACKAGE', Pro/Ace/Kings, 'DOUBLES'), but the playbook is already RAM-resident in a save state, and state boots were measured nondeterministic, so neither a positive nor a negative result would have been attributable.

roster.verifier: NFL2K5_PS2_DISC_ROSTER_VERIFY_PASS edits=2462 names=0 packed=2462 rost=76 outer=5 unchanged_bytes=1073731976
roster.what_was_built: Every primary player's jersey number -> 7 (2462 edits; 17 already wore 7 and were skipped because the writer refuses no-op writes)
roster.why_not: Same frame as colours: the v4800 intro shows jersey numbers 11 and 94 but the patched boot's frame is pixel-identical to stock, so the intro's numbers are not read from the boot roster.

stadium.what_it_would_take: Button injection to reach a real game, then catalogue the specific stadium scene and move a large lane.
stadium.why: Only ONE scene is catalogued (outer entry 1556, chunk 2: 101 shapes, 654 batches, 1041 position lanes). The one input-free scene that renders a stadium is the v4800 Metrodome shot, and that frame proved insensitive to BOTH other disc lanes, so a stadium edit could not have been attributed there either. Cataloguing the remaining 476 scenes to find the Metrodome would have bought a measurement the vehicle cannot make.

text.evidence: All 6873 catalogued strings were decoded from the operator's own ISO and every one matched its catalogue text_sha256 (0 mismatches), so the inventory is complete and trustworthy.
text.what_it_would_take: Button injection to reach the franchise front office.
text.why_not: The four editable banks are STRG 24.65 (1105 franchise/front-office/training labels), STRG 190.1 (8 milestone help blurbs), CRED (608 credits), SITU (100 ESPN-Classic scenario prose), TRIV (4837 trivia). None is drawn by the boot logos, the intro, or the title screen. The in-game HUD strings that ARE on screen in the save states - 'CHOOSE PACKAGE', 'LAST PLAY', 'COACH\'S PICK', 'PAGE 1', '5 yard penalty San Francisco' - are in NO text bank: searched all 6873, zero hits. They live in the ELF or in textures.

vehicle.chosen: COLD BOOT, no save state (-statefile omitted) - every resource loads from the disc under test

cold_boot_determinism.verdict: frame-DETERMINISTIC across two independent stock cold boots

vehicle.why_not_states: All six banked states are mid-game; RAM already holds the stock resources. Measured additionally: save-state boots are NONDETERMINISTIC - the stock state-01/04/06 dumps did not reproduce on a second stock boot, so no stock-vs-patched pixel diff from a state can mean anything.
